name: The Denver Post editorial board
lean_basis: Largest Colorado daily; editorial board has endorsed Democrats and Republicans. Since a 2022 company-wide decision it does not endorse for U.S. Senate or governor. AllSides rates the Denver Post news as Lean Left.

name: The Gazette (Colorado Springs) editorial board
lean_basis: Owned by Clarity Media (Anschutz); the editorial board is consistently conservative and endorsed Republicans in every 2026 candidate race it weighed in on.

name: The Denver Gazette editorial board
lean_basis: Sister paper of the Colorado Springs Gazette (Clarity Media); shares the same editorial board picks on statewide races and measures.

name: The Colorado Sun
lean_basis: Nonprofit newsroom with no editorial board. Its opinion page states: 'The Sun will not publish candidate endorsement submissions, analysis of individual races or columns submitted by candidates in any race.'

name: League of Women Voters of Colorado (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; does not endorse candidates. Publishes candidate questionnaire answers on VOTE411.

name: Colorado Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; lists its general-election nominees.

name: Colorado Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; lists its general-election nominees.

name: Colorado AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation; its 2026 slate endorses only Democrats.

name: Colorado Education Association
lean_basis: State teachers union; its 2026 statewide slate endorses only Democrats.

name: Conservation Colorado
lean_basis: Environmental advocacy group; its 2026 endorsements are all Democrats.

name: Planned Parenthood Votes Colorado
lean_basis: Reproductive-rights advocacy PAC; its 2026 slate endorses only Democrats.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC; grades candidates A through F and endorses the higher-graded candidate, nearly always a Republican.

name: Rocky Mountain Gun Owners
lean_basis: Colorado gun-rights group that describes itself as 'no compromise'; endorses only Republicans.

name: Colorado Chamber of Commerce PAC
lean_basis: Statewide business lobby; endorses candidates of both parties in legislative races, skewing Republican. Does not endorse in statewide executive races.

name: Colorado Fraternal Order of Police
lean_basis: Largest police union in Colorado (10,000-plus officers). The Denver Post notes it 'historically has leaned toward Republican candidates'; in 2026 it endorsed Democrat Phil Weiser for governor.
